lead.en: The framework connects research structure to the contributions used by later studies and the experimental conditions supporting their claims. Checks at each stage determine which comparisons the resulting evidence can support.
lead.zh: 框架把研究结构与后续研究所用的成果、支撑其结论的实验条件连接起来。每一阶段的检验决定所得证据能支持哪些比较。

steps.en: Consensus map
steps.zh: 共识地图

steps.en: SPECTER2 title–abstract similarity combined with bibliographic coupling (α = 4/7); 15 neighbours; 20 seeded Leiden partitions (RBConfiguration, resolution 4); co-assignment matrix partitioned by constant Potts (γ = 0.5)
steps.zh: SPECTER2 标题摘要相似度与文献耦合加权（α = 4/7）；15 近邻；20 次带种子的 Leiden 划分（RBConfiguration，分辨率 4）；共现矩阵用常数 Potts 模型划分（γ = 0.5）

steps.en: Themes
steps.zh: 主题

steps.en: A coarser consensus (RBConfiguration, resolution 1) groups the 61 clusters into 14 themes; c-TF-IDF keywords and member titles describe each group
steps.zh: 更粗的共识划分（RBConfiguration，分辨率 1）把 61 个星团归为 14 个主题；用 c-TF-IDF 关键词和成员标题描述每个组

steps.en: Population
steps.zh: 人群

steps.en: Only works with reference lists enter clustering; 15-neighbour text voting assigns 50 more; the 330 unassigned works stay in period denominators
steps.zh: 只有带参考文献的论文进入聚类；15 近邻文本投票另外归入 50 篇；330 篇未归类论文保留在各时期分母中

p.en: Safety labels describe the resulting groups and five overlapping problem lines but are excluded from the graph: a design-stage comparison found that label-assisted partitions resisted paper deletion yet changed substantially when the annotating model changed. Identifier, date and reference corrections precede the final reconstruction; they preserve 91% of shared works in corresponding themes and the direction of 11 of 12 comparable theme trends.
p.zh: 安全标签用于描述所得的组和五条可重叠的问题主线，但不参与建图：设计阶段的比较发现，加入标签的划分能抵抗论文删减，但换标注模型后变化很大。标识、日期和参考文献修正在最终重建之前完成；修正后对应主题中保留 91% 的共同论文，12 个可比主题趋势中 11 个方向不变。

steps.en: Time-slice maps
steps.zh: 时间切片地图

steps.en: 12 quarterly maps, December 2023 to September 2026, each reconstructed only from works public at that cutoff
steps.zh: 12 个季度地图（2023 年 12 月至 2026 年 9 月），每个只用该截点已公开的论文重建

steps.en: Member flows
steps.zh: 成员流动

steps.en: A link needs a hypergeometric overlap test with Benjamini–Hochberg q ≤ 0.05, at least three shared papers and a flow fraction of at least 0.3
steps.zh: 一条链接需要通过超几何重叠检验（Benjamini–Hochberg q ≤ 0.05）、至少 3 篇共同论文、流动比例至少 0.3

steps.en: Perturbed reruns
steps.zh: 扰动重跑

steps.en: keep(e) = 1{ Wilson lower bound of deletion recurrence ≥ 0.5, ≥ 16/20 seeds, ≥ 4/6 parameter variants }, frozen before 200 confirmatory deletion runs
steps.zh: keep(e) = 1{删减复现的 Wilson 下界 ≥ 0.5，换种子 ≥ 16/20，参数变体 ≥ 4/6}，在 200 次确认删减运行之前冻结

steps.en: Technical cases
steps.zh: 技术案例

steps.en: Source-based reading of retained events: each record names its work, passage, location and support type
steps.zh: 对保留事件做基于原文的阅读：每条记录写明论文、段落、位置和支持类型

p.en: The framework separates a reproducible concentration of research from evidence that it will develop unusually quickly: in a sealed backtest, comparisons with stricter local controls found no stable early-identification advantage.
p.zh: 框架把可复现的研究集中与“它会异常快速发展”的证据区分开：在封存的回测中，与更严格的局部对照相比，没有发现稳定的早期识别优势。

steps.en: Used contribution
steps.zh: 被使用的成果

steps.en: Use records connect a later experiment to the contribution used, its purpose (baseline, evaluation resource, method) and the supporting passage; external use requires no shared authors
steps.zh: 使用记录把后续实验连到被使用的成果、用途（基线、评测资源、方法）和支持原文；外部使用要求没有共同作者

steps.en: Trusted inputs
steps.zh: 可信输入

steps.en: For each defence: the inputs it relies on, who produces them, whether the attacker can influence them, and whether an experiment changes, removes or corrupts them
steps.zh: 对每个防御：依赖哪些输入、由谁产生、攻击者能否影响，以及是否有实验改变、移除或破坏它们

steps.en: Coverage matrix
steps.zh: 覆盖矩阵

steps.en: The closest existing works and their experimental conditions, from in-corpus and targeted outside searches
steps.zh: 最接近的已有工作及其实验条件，来自语料内检索和语料外定向检索

steps.en: Next experiment
steps.zh: 下一步实验

steps.en: A proposal fixes attacker control, trusted components, method adaptation and measurable outcomes; one was run as a condition-transfer experiment
steps.zh: 提案固定攻击者控制、可信组件、方法适配和可测结果；其中一项作为条件迁移实验运行

p.en: Each defence contributes at most one record per input category, and targeted-test frequencies use the defences relying on that input as their denominator. Outcomes distinguish text and tool calls from environment state and consequences. Unreadable or unresolved evidence remains uncertain rather than becoming a confirmed absence of use.
p.zh: 每个防御在每类输入上最多一条记录，针对性检验的频率以依赖该输入的防御为分母。结果层区分文本、工具调用、环境状态和后果。无法读取或未解决的证据保留为不确定，不当作确认没有使用。

title.zh: 收集与来源核查（附录 A.1）

p.en: Candidate discovery used arXiv keyword queries and metadata harvests, official conference and journal catalogues, citation follow-up and curated reading lists; inclusion was assessed through staged model-assisted screening, review of boundary cases and, where needed, full-text resolution. arXiv supplied first-submission dates; Semantic Scholar supplied bibliographic relations and citation contexts; OpenAlex and Crossref supplied supplementary metadata.
p.zh: 候选发现使用 arXiv 关键词检索与元数据收割、官方会议与期刊目录、引用追踪和整理的阅读清单；纳入判断经过分阶段的模型辅助筛选、边界案例复核，必要时读全文。arXiv 提供首次提交日期；Semantic Scholar 提供文献关系与引用上下文；OpenAlex 和 Crossref 提供补充元数据。

p.en: The data revision corrected 126 first-publication dates and recovered reference lists for 315 works; recovery attempted 460 works without references. The final pseudo-reference audit removed 140 keys representing venue or institution names, proceedings or template text, affecting 184 references in 169 works.
p.zh: 数据修订更正了 126 个首次公开日期，为 315 篇论文恢复了参考文献列表（尝试恢复 460 篇无参考文献的论文）。最后的伪参考文献审计删除了 140 个代表会议或机构名称、论文集或模板文字的键，涉及 169 篇论文中的 184 条参考文献。
